title: Canary release checklist + version pinning notes
content:
Personal scratchpad for upcoming canary -> prod rollout (notes to self).

Goal:
- Push model runtime v2.3.1 with kv-cache optimization and quantization profile QP-3. Verify no regressions in latency or hallucination rate for our common prompts.

High-level plan:
1) Deploy canary to 5% traffic region us-west-2 for 24h.
2) Monitor core metrics (below). If stable, increase to 20% for 12h.
3) If stable, 100% staged rollout with 10% increments per 2h.
4) Post-rollout: monitor 72h, freeze model pins for any hotfixes.

Canary config notes:
- Service: model-endpoint-prod
- Canary variant: runtime-v2.3.1-qp3
- Fallback policy: runtime-v2.3.0 (non-qp) automatically on >1% overall 5xx or >10% latency regressions for 10m window
- Traffic split: initially 95/5 new/old
- Pin customer-important routes: route-id: billing-invoices, support-chat -> keep on v2.3.0 until validated (override flag: pin.billing=true)

Metrics to watch (dashboard ids in linked artifacts):
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 token-generation latency (baseline vs canary): alert if p95 increase > 20% for 30m
- Error rate: 5xx, 4xx from gateway and runtime -> alert if >1% 5xx sustained 10m
- Quality regressions: rerank eval for 20 sample prompts (daily job) - investigate if relevance drop >5 pts
- Token cost: tokens/sec and cost/unit - flag if cost increases >15%
- KV cache hit rate: expect >= 60% for long-running chats; investigate if drop >15pp

Rollback criteria (hard):
- Any sustained >1% production 5xx for 10m AND correlated with canary traffic
- p95 latency reg > 50% for 15m
- Quality regression failing smoke evals for critical prompts

Rollback procedure (quick):
- Manual: patch traffic routing via console -> route all traffic to runtime-v2.3.0 and set fallback true
- Automated: if autopilot triggers fallback, open incident and notify on #releases
- Post-rollback: collect heap/trace, save traces to s3://releases-debug/<timestamp> and tag PR #988

Smoke tests to run when canary flips to 5%:
- curl tests: 
  - curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"runtime-v2.3.1-qp3","prompt":"Summarize the last invoice in 2 lines"}' -> expect: 1) fast response < 300ms p50, 2) key terms present (invoice id, amount)
- local eval harness: run ./scripts/qa_smoke.sh --suite=critical_prompts --target=runtime-v2.3.1-qp3
- embed/rerank smoke: run 20 queries from rerank-checklist.csv; verify top1 relevance >= 0.8 compared to baseline

Version pinning notes (remember):
- Customers with SLA opt-in (acct: corp-123, corp-77) need explicit pinning in customer config. Sync with account-team before rollout.
- Flag format: runtime_pin: runtime-v2.3.0 or runtime-v2.3.1-qp3. Store in config-store under /customers/<acct>/serving_pins
- Migration: add backfill job to move non-pinned customers to new default post-72h window (note: watch for large fleets)

Open questions / TODOs:
- (TODO) Confirm if model catalog entry for runtime-v2.3.1-qp3 needs manual addition to catalog service (ping Maya).
- (Q) Should we gate canary increase on cost delta as well as latency? propose small throttles if cost > 10%
- (TODO) Add small synthetic load test with 100 RPS for 10m to validate autoscaler config (scale-up latency check)
- (TODO) Add trace sampling for canary at 100% for 1h then 10% thereafter
- (Q) Verify KMS keys rotation window doesn't coincide with rollout window (coord with security)

Notes to self / miscellaneous:
- Keep Slack template ready in #releases: short blurb + links to dashboard + rollback cmd
- PR #988 includes the kernel selection fix - remember to re-run integration test that previously flaked (integration/long-seq).
- If we see subtle quality diffs, run regression harness on eval-suite-bert-anchors and open a triage with Applied ML (Isaac).

Quick commands to remember:
- Force rollback traffic split (console): setTrafficSplit --service model-endpoint-prod --from runtime-v2.3.1-qp3 --to runtime-v2.3.0 --percent 100
- Manual pin: curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/pin -d '{"account":"corp-123","runtime":"runtime-v2.3.0"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'

Last check: confirm Canary runbook link (Confluence) updated with exact metric thresholds – otherwise update before starting.

End of scratchpad. Keep this doc informal. Will copy cleaned checklist to shared_drives/release-engineering/runbooks after validation.
